usedFor: DevRev sends events like “Work Created”, and viaSocket utilities holds the run for X minutes with “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “Work Created” in DevRev, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: It holds the workflow for X minutes after a new Work item is created in DevRev.

watchOut: “Work Updated” in DevRev fires whenever Work changes, so “Pause Workflow” can start again for the same item.
